message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live environmental data, so I can’t tell you the current Air Quality Index (AQI) for Los Angeles right now.  

If you’d like up‑to‑date information, you can check one of the following resources:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow.gov** | Enter “Los Angeles” in the search box to see the latest AQI, pollutant levels, and forecast. |
| **EPA Air Quality API** | Use the public API (`https://www.airnowapi.org/aq/observation/latLong/current/`) with your latitude/longitude for LA. |
| **Weather apps** | Most weather apps (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the built‑in weather app on iOS/Android) display AQI for major cities. |
| **Google Search** | Typing “LA air quality” or “Los Angeles AQI” into Google will show a quick card with the current index. |

If you need help interpreting the AQI values or want to know how to protect yourself from poor air quality, let me know!
